lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Quasi-rectilinear grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters. Four primary horizontal rows are visible posterior to the gill slits, with inter-centroid distances remaining relatively constant across the visible mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a cellular grid structure on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the ridge crest and a shadow gradient immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast luminance clusters located primarily within the ventral-anterior region of the dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear horizontal lesion at the posterior insertion point of the dorsal fin. Large V-shaped notch on the posterior margin of the dorsal fin. Three elongated low-luminance objects (ectoparasites/remoras) attached to the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced irregular indentation on the dorsal fin's posterior trailing edge near the apex.
